Dwarf 3 by Dwarflab

Pocket-size smart scope with dual cameras and AI tracking.

around $600

Dwarflab's third-generation smart telescope: a telephoto camera plus a wide-angle camera in a package smaller than a soda can, with AI subject tracking. Shoots the Moon, Sun (with filter), deep sky — and birds by day.

Why we like it

  • Dual cameras: telephoto + wide-angle in one device
  • AI tracking follows moving subjects automatically
  • Extremely portable — fits in a jacket pocket

Keep in mind

  • Small sensor versus dedicated astro cameras
  • App-centric workflow — limited manual control
  • Newer ecosystem, smaller user community

Specs

Telephoto150 mm equivalent, f/4.3
SensorSony IMX678
ControliOS / Android app
Weight~1.2 kg
